description: This file contains utility functions for generating test reports, summaries, and diagnostics for Cypress end-to-end tests, including reading/writing JSON files, removing old reports, and sending reports via HTTP.

methods.name: getAllTests
methods.description: Recursively collects all tests from nested results, accumulating their durations.

methods.name: generateStatsFieldValue
methods.description: Generates a markdown-formatted string summarizing test statistics and failed test titles.

methods.name: generateShortSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary object with test results and statistics, optionally enriched with dashboard data.

methods.name: removeOldGeneratedReports
methods.description: Deletes old report files from the report directory.

methods.name: writeJsonToFile
methods.description: Writes a JSON object to a specified file.

methods.name: readJsonFromFile
methods.description: Reads and parses JSON data from a file, returning an error object if failed.

methods.name: generateTestReport
methods.description: Creates a detailed or brief report object for test results, including environment info and links.

methods.name: generateTitle
methods.description: Generates a report title based on environment variables such as build type and branch.

methods.name: generateDiagnosticReport
methods.description: Creates a diagnostic report with environment and build info for troubleshooting.

methods.name: sendReport
methods.description: Sends a report via HTTP POST request and logs success or failure.
